column1: # event<TAB>reason<TAB>row. The allowlist of scripts/check-hot-events.sh, per EVENT NAME (the cost class is the name: one `onpointermove` makes the event a blocking request app-wide, so a per-site entry would hide one cost many times).

# `event` is a column of the gate: a hot name of primitives/src/ts/bridge.ts's EVENTS table (`hot: 1`), `mounted` (onmounted) or `pd_<event>` (an rsx `prevent_default` on a payload event: submit, input, change, paste, drop).

# A column with a measured rsx site and no row here is red (a new event name on the vdom is the owner's decision); a row with no site left is stale and red. Every reason names the lane that drains the name and the row must exist.

column2: Select's list keeps its scroll position through two onscroll handlers (S2/S3); the bridge observe with a page-side reducer replaces them
per-row and per-container onresize (virtual list, table rows, virtual grid, chart, slider, resizable, color picker, select list): one observe-by-key stream replaces them
chart hover and the context-menu submenu pointer tracking; bridge listen/sample replaces them
the input primitive forwards an optional owner onwheel handler through events::onwheel; the owner decides, the wheel band behaviour replaces the forward
row reorder and drag-and-drop list drop-target tracking, which cancel dragover to accept the drop; a named behaviour replaces them
the element handle (MountedData) that focus, scroll and measurement calls need, one per mounted element and one per collection row; a container handle and a batched observe replace the per-row ones
an rsx prevent_default on drop (date segment, drag-and-drop list, reorder previews): not a mobile cancel candidate; the dropAnywhere behaviour or a declarative cancel replaces it
the date segment cancels paste inside an rsx handler: on Android a payload event can lose the cancel; the otpFilter-style page-side behaviour replaces it
DemoForm and the questionnaire cancel submit inside an rsx handler (DemoForm is immune by construction per the root doc, its form carries method=dialog); a declarative cancel replaces them
